og_description: Han Li studies the world's real map: Inner Sea vs. Outer Sea, demonic beasts that rival Nascent Souls, and a neutral city where even wanted criminals walk free. The hunting grounds are open.

lore_anchors.definition: A public fighting competition held every hundred years at Heaven Star City; the winner becomes the lord of an Outer Star Island, wielding regional authority.
A valuable energy core harvested from demonic beasts; a high-grade core can fund a Foundation Establishment cultivator’s entire cultivation path.

The two mysterious, never-seen rulers of the Star Palace, believed to be either late-stage Nascent Soul or Deity Transformation level beings whose names have dominated the sea for nearly a thousand years.
The unexplored, beast-infested peripheral regions of the Starfall Sea, home to demonic beasts capable of standing against Nascent Soul cultivators.
The explored, civilized portion of the Starfall Sea controlled by the Star Palace and its affiliated islands.
